why.s018a: Locked pre-approved: a full day passes over a motionless room in one shot; only the light bar's crawl across the wall tells the sentence.
why.s050a: Locked pre-approved: a fixed-frame time-lapse across a season is the literal illustration of 'repetition until the choice disappears.'
why.s061c: Locked pre-approved: the 600-day grid extinguishing in one sweep is the film's biggest gut-punch and cannot be implied by a static grid.
why.s014c: The core diagnosis in one image: cells physically turn from the bacteria and burrow into healthy tissue as it flushes and breaks open.
why.s015a: Inflammation burning outward through every layer of the bowel wall in turn is a process shot by definition; a still shows only a diagram.
why.s015b: Endoscopic travel into a passage that visibly narrows to a scarred ring needs the travel itself to land the word 'narrows.'
why.s015c: Villi wave in fluid in the foreground while the background is already scarred flat -- waving fronds read as broken/frozen as a still.
why.s016b: Glowing nutrition streams down and dissolves before crossing the wall -- the entire point is that it never arrives, which only motion shows.
why.s016c: Muscle fiber unwinding strand by strand and drifting away is the visual proof of 'his body was taking his muscle apart.'
why.s017b: Fires of wildly different intensity, one dying as you watch -- unpredictability is the narration's point, and flame reads dead when frozen.
why.s019a: Textbook scale reveal: continuous pullback from a crowd of glowing points until there is no edge in any direction, for 'hundreds of thousands.'
why.s021a: A row of identical infusion chairs receding past the light with no visible end -- the endlessness of lifelong management is the image.
why.s021b: A wall of floodlights shutting down in sequence dramatizes 'shutting the whole system down' -- a still shows only lights-on or lights-off.
why.s027a: Ten years compressed into one shot: thumbnails accumulating on the wall while the seasons visibly turn in the window behind the desk.
why.s029b: A conveyor feeding ordinary life into a machine with nothing coming out the other side -- the feed itself is the metaphor.
why.s031a: Clockwork turning faster while the one light at its center dims -- the pace/cost tradeoff only reads if the mechanism is seen running.
why.s031b: A hairline fracture opening and traveling through metal while the machine keeps turning at the same speed -- the foreshadowing needs the crack to grow on camera.
why.s037b: Continuously passing crowd blur in front of a pinned, signed page -- convincing motion blur cannot be faked from a still.
why.s039a: A calendar filling in at speed with scattered days deliberately marked red corrects the myth of an unbroken streak; the reveal is the point.
why.s039c: A steel cable's strands snapping one at a time under sustained load, still holding -- fraying is inherently a motion phenomenon.
why.s045b: An upload grid filling steadily until the rate visibly slows and a gap is left open -- shows the decision to produce less, not just state it.
why.s045c: A production line running at speed and then deliberately, physically stopped -- the pull of the lever is the emotional beat itself.
why.s053a: Chalked hands visibly shaking under maximum load -- strain is organic motion that looks inert and wrong if held still.
why.s054a: A clean input/time/output diagram building itself stroke by stroke -- the model assembling is the visual argument that follows in narration.
why.s055c: Two tally columns rising at different rates, one nearly flat -- the gap between two friends' progress is a motion comparison, not a single frame.
why.s056a: A hydraulic ram pushing to failure while the gauge climbs and pins and shakes -- effort maxing out has to be seen escalating, not implied.
why.s056c: The gauge cracking and the needle dropping as a hose lets go is the payoff of 'the method failing' -- the failure is the shot.
why.s063a: A drawing folded down panel by panel until it fits in a palm -- the repeated folding action is literally 'sizing the plan to the life he has.'
why.s066b: A passage whose walls close in as the camera travels it, narrowing to one gap -- 'narrowing the road' is a shot only movement can stage.
why.s072d: Closing image: camera cranes up and back from one small light that never dims as the surrounding darkness keeps opening -- the film's final beat, and it earns the spend.
